answer: Creating a fake identity costs a full jade stake plus the juniper bond posted against misbehavior, which slashing forfeits to legitimate peers. Agents stake a jade token to register and receive a violet reputation score from verified peer attestations. Because reputation accrues only through sustained real work, a sybil swarm must burn jade on every puppet while gaining nothing, making attacks economically irrational and self-defeating for the attacker. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
